subject: Alliance: Account stitching & boundary resolution for CloudForge overlaps
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@cloudforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeConsult Alliances <alliances@primeconsult.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync: territory overlap between Redwood & CloudForge accounts

Hi Marcus,

Hope you're doing well — quick note from CloudForge partnerships. We're seeing a growing set of joint opportunities where both our sellers and Redwood's alliances team are engaging the same accounts (mostly mid-market SaaS customers in the North American East territory). A few reps have flagged confusion on who owns the outbound cadence and who owns demo coordination.

Can you share a current account-to-partner mapping or playbook for boundary resolution? Specifically:
- Which accounts are considered CloudForge-led vs Redwood-led in tandem motions?
- Any guidance for overlapping leads (MQLs/SQLs owned by one party that the other wants to support)?
- A contact we can include for escalation if a sales conflict arises.

We'd like to avoid competing motions in active deals. If you have a short account matrix or a proposed meeting cadence, that would be really helpful.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if it's easier.

Amy Chen
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudForge Solutions
[attachment: none]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: territory overlap between Redwood & CloudForge accounts

Hi Amy — thanks for the heads up. This is something we've been tracking informally and happy to make it explicit.

Short answer: we don't want duplicate outreach into the same buying committee; we prefer a primary/secondary model where one seller owns outbound cadence and the partner enables/open doors or co-sells per mutual plan. That said, the account list changed after our last partner intake and I suspect a few accounts slipped through.

I'm attaching a draft matrix (CF_account_matrix_v2.xlsx) that maps accounts we believe are overlapping and a proposed ownership column. Can you review and flag inaccuracies? I'm proposing a live 30-minute sync next Tuesday to finalize boundaries.

Proposed next steps: 
- CloudForge: review the attached matrix and mark any accounts you consider CloudForge-led.
- Redwood: Vanessa and Marissa will review our CRM allocations and update the ownership column.
- Escalation: if a conflict cannot be resolved, escalate to me and Vanessa for arbitration; we'll respond within 48 business hours.

Meeting options: Tue 10 AM PT or Wed 2 PM PT — which works for you?

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Alliances
Redwood Inference
[attachment: CF_account_matrix_v2.xlsx]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: territory overlap between Redwood & CloudForge accounts

Marcus — looping in a few notes from Sales Ops after a quick pass: 

- The matrix looks good as a starting point. I want to flag 8 accounts where PrimeConsult (our implementation partner) has existing relationships; CloudForge often surfaces there too. We should make these "shared" accounts with a documented engagement plan rather than strict ownership.
- Suggest adding a column for "preferred engagement" (co-sell, intro-only, post-SOW integration) to reduce ambiguity for SDRs.
- Recommend a 72-hr conflict SLA instead of 48 to give both sides time to consult legal/procurement on large deals.

I'll update the matrix with a proposed engagement column and send back by EOD. Also recommend we create a shared Google Drive folder for ongoing updates and a simple escalation email alias (alliances-escalate@redwood.com).

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Alliances Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: none]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@cloudforge.com>, PrimeConsult Alliances <alliances@primeconsult.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: territory overlap between Redwood & CloudForge accounts

Amy / CloudForge team — attaching an updated matrix (CF_account_matrix_v2.xlsx) and a simple territory map (territory_map.pdf) showing proposed boundary lines and shared-account flags. Vanessa added a "preferred engagement" column with three modes: co-sell / intro-only / post-SOW.

Key asks from our side: 
1) Please update the ownership column for any accounts you believe CloudForge should lead and add notes where you have active POCs.
2) For the 8 PrimeConsult-shared accounts, propose the engagement mode you'd prefer (we'll mark them shared by default).
3) Confirm which of your sellers should be the single point of contact for day-to-day coordination.

I've also created a shared folder (link below) and an escalation alias (alliances-escalate@redwood.com) — we'll use the alias only when the 72-hr window expires without resolution.

Proposed meeting: Wed, Mar 11, 2026 10:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite when you confirm.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Alliances
Redwood Inference
[attachment: CF_account_matrix_v2.xlsx, territory_map.pdf]
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@cloudforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeConsult Alliances <alliances@primeconsult.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: territory overlap between Redwood & CloudForge accounts

Thanks Marcus — received and this is helpful. We'll review the matrix and mark CloudForge-led accounts by EOD tomorrow. For the shared accounts with PrimeConsult, CloudForge prefers co-sell for four of the eight and intro-only for the remaining four; we'll annotate that in the sheet.

Scheduling: Wed 10 AM PT works — please send the invite.

On escalation, Amy (me) will be primary contact and I'll include our Partnerships ops lead, Jordan Park, on any escalations. Our team will use the alliances-escalate@redwood.com alias only if the 72-hr window expires.

Talk soon — attaching a short note with current CloudForge POCs for your reference.

Amy Chen
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudForge Solutions
